title: Landfall and Wreck
author: Sebastian Amberdale
blurb: Hazel Sandoval, a desert ranger tracking a thief across nothing, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. Then an expedition upriver stops answering the radio — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
